description: Product Description Burgol Shoe Wax for High Gloss With the shoe cream from Burgol, the shoe lover receives a first-class product for the care of their smooth leather shoes. The shoe wax has excellent shine and protection properties and relies on natural ingredients. These include, among others, the resin-free balsam turpentine oil, which is used here instead of the now widely used test benzene as a solvent. In addition, it cleans and guarantees an optimal consistency of the shoe cream. First-class care properties thanks to various waxes The use of impregnating sprays for smooth leather is not necessary. The protective and impregnating effect of the shoe cream from Burgol, as well as the long-lasting shine, are achieved thanks to the combination of various natural waxes, such as hard palm wax (carnauba wax), beeswax, and other types of wax. The special color brilliance is achieved through the use of color pigments. However, it is advisable to combine it with the color-matching pomade. By the way: The shoe wax from Burgol is perfect for a water shine polish. Burgol shoe cream is economical to use For normal use, please apply the shoe wax sparingly with a polishing cloth (or brush) on the shaft, following the motto "less is more". The shoe cream is extremely economical to use. The 100 ml can is enough to care for more than 200 pairs of medium-sized shoes. Let the wax work for at least 15 minutes and then polish the shoe with a soft-bristled polishing brush. The Burgol shoe cream is available in ten variants (black, dark brown, medium brown, light brown, bordeaux, blue, gray, green, red, and colorless), which can of course also be mixed with each other to achieve the look of an extraordinary antique finish. title: Burgol Pomade - Medium Brown
description: Product Description Burgol Pomade for vibrant smooth leather Pomade for smooth leather shoes by Burgol. With this high-quality mixed emulsion cream, the care range of the Swiss traditional company is further enhanced and guarantees successful and uncomplicated care for smooth leather. Together with the palm wax shoe cream, the shoe polisher receives everything he needs for deep-acting and protective shoe care. The 100 ml jar of pomade contains nourishing oils and waxes that penetrate deep into the leather and restore lost nutrients. In addition, Burgol's pomade contains natural color pigments that activate color and fill faded leather with volume. Furthermore, the leather receives a subtle silk shine after the final polish with Burgol's pomade. Five minutes is all it takes Whether a cloth or brush is used to apply the pomade, it doesn't matter. The important thing is to evenly distribute the cream on the upper leather. After that, only five minutes of exposure time is needed before brushing can begin. It is ideal to use the pomade in combination with Burgol's palm wax shoe cream, which can be applied afterwards or alternately to protect the leather - both care products together ensure optimal care and protection for the leather. Burgol's pomade is available in 15 different shades (pure white, colorless, beige, gray, black, cognac, light brown, nut, medium brown, chestnut, dark brown, red, bordeaux, blue, and green), which can also be mixed with each other. Product details Brand Burgol Reviews
description_es: Descripción del producto Pomada Burgol para cuero liso vibrante Pomada para zapatos de cuero liso de Burgol. Con esta crema en emulsión mixta de alta calidad se amplía aún más la gama de cuidados de la tradicional empresa suiza y se garantiza un cuidado exitoso y sencillo del cuero liso. Junto con la crema para zapatos con cera de palma, el lustrador de zapatos recibe todo lo que necesita para un cuidado protector y profundo del calzado. El tarro de pomada de 100 ml contiene aceites y ceras nutritivos que penetran profundamente en el cuero y devuelven los nutrientes perdidos. Además, la pomada de Burgol contiene pigmentos de color naturales que activan el color y llenan de volumen el cuero descolorido. Además, el cuero adquiere un sutil brillo sedoso después del pulido final con la pomada de Burgol. Cinco minutos es todo lo que necesitas. Ya sea que se use un paño o un cepillo para aplicar la pomada, no importa. Lo importante es distribuir uniformemente la crema sobre la piel superior. Después de eso, solo se necesitan cinco minutos de exposición antes de que pueda comenzar el cepillado. Lo ideal es utilizar la pomada en combinación con la crema para zapatos de cera de palma de Burgol, que se puede aplicar después o alternativamente para proteger el cuero; ambos productos de cuidado juntos garantizan un cuidado y protección óptimos para el cuero. La pomada de Burgol está disponible en 15 tonos diferentes (blanco puro, incoloro, beige, gris, negro, coñac, marrón claro, nuez, marrón medio, castaño, marrón oscuro, rojo, burdeos, azul y verde), que también se pueden mezclar entre sí. title: Burgol Shoe Cream - Beige
description: Product Description  Burgol Shoe Wax for High Gloss With the shoe cream from Burgol, the shoe lover receives a first-class product for the care of their smooth leather shoes. The shoe wax has excellent shine and protection properties and relies on natural ingredients. These include, among others, the resin-free balsam turpentine oil, which is used as a solvent instead of the now widely used test benzene. In addition, it cleans and guarantees an optimal consistency of the shoe cream. First-class care properties thanks to various waxesThe use of impregnating sprays for smooth leather is not necessary. The protective and impregnating effect of the shoe cream from Burgol, as well as the long-lasting shine, are achieved thanks to the combination of various natural waxes, such as hard palm wax (carnauba wax), beeswax, and other types of wax. The special color brilliance is achieved through the use of color pigments. However, it is advisable to combine it with the color-matching pomade. By the way: The shoe wax from Burgol is perfect for a water shine polish.Burgol shoe cream is economical to useFor normal use, please apply the shoe wax sparingly with a polishing cloth (or brush) on the shaft, following the motto "less is more". The shoe cream is extremely economical to use. The 100ml can is enough to care for more than 200 pairs of medium-sized shoes. Let the wax sit for at least 15 minutes and then polish the shoe with a soft-bristled polishing brush. The Burgol shoe cream is available in ten variations (black, dark brown, medium brown, light brown, bordeaux, blue, gray, green, red, and colorless), which can also be mixed together to achieve the look of an extraordinary antique finish. La cera para zapatos tiene excelentes propiedades de brillo y protección y se basa en ingredientes naturales. Estos incluyen, entre otros, el aceite bálsamo de trementina sin resina, que se utiliza como disolvente en lugar del benceno de prueba, ahora ampliamente utilizado. Además, limpia y garantiza una consistencia óptima de la crema para zapatos. Propiedades de cuidado de primera clase gracias a diferentes ceras. title: Burgol Shoe Cream
description: Product Description Burgol Shoe Wax for High Gloss With the shoe cream from Burgol, the shoe lover receives a first-class product for the care of their smooth leather shoes. The shoe wax has excellent shine and protection properties and relies on natural ingredients. These include, among others, the resin-free balsam turpentine oil, which is used here instead of the now widely used test benzene as a solvent. In addition, it cleans and guarantees an optimal consistency of the shoe cream. First-class care properties thanks to various waxes The use of impregnating sprays for smooth leather is not necessary. The protective and impregnating effect of the shoe cream from Burgol, as well as the long-lasting shine, are achieved thanks to the combination of various natural waxes, such as hard palm wax (carnauba wax), beeswax, and other types of wax. The special color brilliance is achieved through the use of color pigments. However, it is advisable to combine it with the color-matching pomade. By the way: The shoe wax from Burgol is perfect for a water shine polish. Burgol shoe cream is economical to use For normal use, please apply the shoe wax sparingly with a polishing cloth (or brush) on the shaft, following the motto "less is more". The shoe cream is extremely economical to use. The 100 ml can is enough to care for more than 200 pairs of medium-sized shoes. Let the wax work for at least 15 minutes and then polish the shoe with a soft-bristled polishing brush. The Burgol shoe cream is available in ten variants (black, dark brown, medium brown, light brown, bordeaux, blue, gray, green, red, and colorless), which can of course also be mixed with each other to achieve the look of an extraordinary antique finish. Reviews

La cera para zapatos tiene excelentes propiedades de brillo y protección y se basa en ingredientes naturales. Estos incluyen, entre otros, el aceite bálsamo de trementina sin resina, que se utiliza aquí en lugar del benceno de prueba, ahora ampliamente utilizado, como disolvente. Además, limpia y garantiza una consistencia óptima de la crema para zapatos. Propiedades de cuidado de primera clase gracias a diferentes ceras. No es necesario el uso de aerosoles impregnantes para cuero liso. El efecto protector e impregnante de la crema para zapatos de Burgol, así como el brillo duradero, se consiguen gracias a la combinación de diversas ceras naturales, como la cera dura de palma (cera de carnauba), la cera de abejas y otros tipos de cera. El brillo especial del color se consigue mediante el uso de pigmentos cromáticos. Sin embargo, es recomendable combinarlo con la pomada del mismo color. Por cierto: la cera para zapatos de Burgol es perfecta para abrillantar al agua. La crema para zapatos de Burgol es económica de usar. title: Burgol Shoe Polish - Black
description: Product Description Burgol Shoe Wax for High Gloss With the shoe cream from Burgol, the shoe lover receives a first-class product for the care of their smooth leather shoes. The shoe wax has excellent shine and protection properties and relies on natural ingredients. These include, among others, the resin-free balsam turpentine oil, which is used here instead of the now widely used test benzene as a solvent. In addition, it cleans and guarantees an optimal consistency of the shoe cream. First-class care properties thanks to various waxes The use of impregnating sprays for smooth leather is not necessary. The protective and impregnating effect of the shoe cream from Burgol, as well as the long-lasting shine, are achieved thanks to the combination of various natural waxes, such as hard palm wax (carnauba wax), beeswax, and other types of wax. The special color brilliance is achieved through the use of color pigments. However, it is advisable to combine it with the color-matching pomade. By the way: The shoe wax from Burgol is perfect for a water shine polish. Burgol shoe cream is economical to use For normal use, please apply the shoe wax sparingly with a polishing cloth (or brush) on the shaft, following the motto "less is more". The shoe cream is extremely economical to use. The 100 ml can is enough to care for more than 200 pairs of medium-sized shoes. Let the wax work for at least 15 minutes and then polish the shoe with a soft-bristled polishing brush. The Burgol shoe cream is available in ten variants (black, dark brown, medium brown, light brown, bordeaux, blue, gray, green, red, and colorless), which can of course also be mixed with each other to achieve the look of an extraordinary antique finish. Product details Brand Burgol Reviews
description_es: Descripción del producto Cera para zapatos Burgol de alto brillo Con la crema para zapatos de Burgol, el amante de los zapatos recibe un producto de primera clase para el cuidado de sus zapatos de piel lisa. These include, among others, the resin-free balsam turpentine oil, which is used here instead of the now widely used test benzene as a solvent. In addition, it cleans and guarantees an optimal consistency of the shoe cream. First-class care properties thanks to various waxes The use of impregnating sprays for smooth leather is not necessary. The protective and impregnating effect of the shoe cream from Burgol, as well as the long-lasting shine, are achieved thanks to the combination of various natural waxes, such as hard palm wax (carnauba wax), beeswax, and other types of wax. The special color brilliance is achieved through the use of color pigments. However, it is advisable to combine it with the color-matching pomade. By the way: The shoe wax from Burgol is perfect for a water shine polish. Burgol shoe cream is economical to use For normal use, please apply the shoe wax sparingly with a polishing cloth (or brush) on the shaft, following the motto "less is more". The shoe cream is extremely economical to use. The 100 ml can is enough to care for more than 200 pairs of medium-sized shoes. Let the wax work for at least 15 minutes and then polish the shoe with a soft-bristled polishing brush. The Burgol shoe cream is available in ten variants (black, dark brown, medium brown, light brown, bordeaux, blue, gray, green, red, and colorless), which can of course also be mixed with each other to achieve the look of an extraordinary antique finish. title: Burgol Pomade - Black
description: Product Description Burgol Pomade for vibrant smooth leather Pomade for smooth leather shoes by Burgol. With this high-quality mixed emulsion cream, the care range of the Swiss traditional company is further enhanced and guarantees successful and uncomplicated care for smooth leather. Together with the palm wax shoe cream, the shoe polisher receives everything he needs for deep-acting and protective shoe care. The 100 ml jar of pomade contains nourishing oils and waxes that penetrate deep into the leather and restore lost nutrients. In addition, Burgol's pomade contains natural color pigments that activate color and fill faded leather with volume. Furthermore, the leather receives a subtle silk shine after the final polish with Burgol's pomade. Five minutes is all it takes Whether a cloth or brush is used to apply the pomade, it doesn't matter. The important thing is to evenly distribute the cream on the upper leather. After that, only five minutes of exposure time is needed before brushing can begin. It is ideal to use the pomade in combination with Burgol's palm wax shoe cream, which can be applied afterwards or alternately to protect the leather - both care products together ensure optimal care and protection for the leather. Burgol's pomade is available in 15 different shades (pure white, colorless, beige, gray, black, cognac, light brown, nut, medium brown, chestnut, dark brown, red, bordeaux, blue, and green), which can also be mixed with each other. Reviews
description_es: Descripción del producto Pomada Burgol para cuero liso vibrante Pomada para zapatos de cuero liso de Burgol. Con esta crema en emulsión mixta de alta calidad se amplía aún más la gama de cuidados de la tradicional empresa suiza y se garantiza un cuidado exitoso y sencillo del cuero liso. Junto con la crema para zapatos con cera de palma, el lustrador de zapatos recibe todo lo que necesita para un cuidado protector y profundo del calzado. El tarro de pomada de 100 ml contiene aceites y ceras nutritivos que penetran profundamente en el cuero y devuelven los nutrientes perdidos. Además, la pomada de Burgol contiene pigmentos de color naturales que activan el color y llenan de volumen el cuero descolorido. Además, el cuero adquiere un sutil brillo sedoso después del pulido final con la pomada de Burgol. Cinco minutos es todo lo que necesitas. Ya sea que se use un paño o un cepillo para aplicar la pomada, no importa. Lo importante es distribuir uniformemente la crema sobre la piel superior. Después de eso, solo se necesitan cinco minutos de exposición antes de que pueda comenzar el cepillado. Lo ideal es utilizar la pomada en combinación con la crema para zapatos de cera de palma de Burgol, que se puede aplicar después o alternativamente para proteger el cuero; ambos productos de cuidado juntos garantizan un cuidado y protección óptimos para el cuero. La pomada de Burgol está disponible en 15 tonos diferentes (blanco puro, incoloro, beige, gris, negro, coñac, marrón claro, nuez, marrón medio, castaño, marrón oscuro, rojo, burdeos, azul y verde), que también se pueden mezclar entre sí. title: Burgol White Cleaner Plus Kit - Colorless
description: Product Description  Practical complete care set for sneakers and shoes with white rubber sole.  Burgol White Cleaner Plus, Burgol Sneaker Brush, Burgol Microfiber Cloth  When it comes to sneaker care, cleaning the smooth white surface remains the biggest challenge to this day. With our previous White Cleaner, we were able to prove that it can be quite simple. Previously, an additional sneaker cleaner was needed for the remaining areas of the sneaker. We have now combined both products. The previous function of sneaker cleaning, especially the sole edges, remains intact. Dirt is still mechanically lifted from the plastic surfaces with "micro-earthquakes" and not simply chemically dissolved. This works so gently that it has no effect on the material. Additionally, we have now integrated a highly effective sneaker cleaner into the White Cleaner Plus. Previously, an additional cleaner was needed for all other materials on the sneaker, but now you have everything in one product - a sole edge cleaner and a sneaker cleaner. Application: After brushing off the loose dirt from the sole edges with the Burgol Sneaker Brush, the surface is sprayed with the White Cleaner Plus. Wait for 60 seconds before wiping it off with a clean cloth, such as the JUNIOR microfiber cloth. Treat the remaining areas of the sneaker in the same way. For additional support, you can also brush the sneaker while it is still wet after the product has been applied.  Content: 200ml  Reviews

In a sophisticated dark brown, it combines top-quality care and stylish elegance - an essential accessory for discerning shoe lovers. From high-quality brushes to cream and wax - perfect for flawlessly maintained shoes. Professional care packaged with Christmas charm meets all your shoe care needs. Included in the care sets are: 1x Horsehair Brush: Removes dust and coarse dirt from the surface of the shoe. Ideal as a first step before thorough cleaning. 1x Smooth Leather Cleaner (155 ml): Cleans smooth leather types from deep dirt, stains or residues. 1x Suede Cleaner (100 ml): Specifically designed for cleaning suede and nubuck leather, as these materials are more delicate and require gentle cleaning. 1x frame brush: cleaning of edges, seams and hard-to-reach areas. 1x Crepe Brush: Activates the fibers of suede leather, allowing them to regain their typical texture. Usually applied before the waterproofing spray. 1x Shoe Polish (50 ml): Nourishes and nourishes the leather, restores the color, and makes the leather supple again. 1x Application Brush: For evenly applying cream or wax to the shoe, especially in difficult areas. 1x Shoe Wax (50 ml): Used after the cream, it provides a shiny surface and protects against water and dirt. 1x Shoe Polishing Cloth: Use to polish after applying cream or wax for a shiny finish. 1x Waterproofing Spray (250 ml): Apply after care to protect the shoe from water and dirt without compromising breathability. This order ensures that your shoes are cleaned, nourished, protected, and polished optimally - for a long lifespan and a well-groomed appearance. Reviews
title_es: Set de cuidado del cuero para pieles lisas y ante - Marrón oscuro
description_es: Descripción del producto Añade un toque de brillo navideño a tus zapatos con el exclusivo set de cuidado del calzado de Henry Stevens. En un sofisticado marrón oscuro, combina un cuidado de primera calidad y una elegancia con estilo: un accesorio imprescindible para los amantes del calzado más exigentes. Desde cepillos de alta calidad hasta crema y cera, perfectos para un calzado con un mantenimiento impecable. El cuidado profesional empaquetado con un adorno navideño satisface todas sus necesidades de cuidado de calzado. El set de cuidado incluye: 1 cepillo de crin: elimina el polvo y la suciedad gruesa de la superficie del zapato. Ideal como primer paso antes de una limpieza a fondo. 1x Limpiador de cuero liso (155 ml): Limpia los tipos de cuero liso de suciedad, manchas o residuos profundos. 1x Limpiador de ante (100 ml): Diseñado específicamente para la limpieza de pieles de ante y nobuck, ya que estos materiales son más delicados y requieren una limpieza suave. 1 cepillo para marcos: limpieza de bordes, costuras y zonas de difícil acceso. 1x Crepe Brush: Activa las fibras del ante, permitiéndoles recuperar su textura típica. Generalmente se aplica antes del spray impermeabilizante. 1x Betún para zapatos (50 ml): Nutre y cuida el cuero, restaura el color y devuelve el cuero a su flexibilidad. 1x Brocha de aplicación: Para aplicar uniformemente crema o cera al zapato, especialmente en zonas difíciles. 1x Cera para zapatos (50 ml): Utilizada después de la crema, proporciona una superficie brillante y protege contra el agua y la suciedad. 1 paño para pulir zapatos: Úselo para pulir después de aplicar crema o cera para obtener un acabado brillante. 1x Spray Impermeabilizante (250 ml): Aplicar después del cuidado para proteger el zapato del agua y la suciedad sin comprometer la transpirabilidad. Este pedido garantiza que sus zapatos estén limpios, nutridos, protegidos y pulidos de manera óptima, para una larga vida útil y una apariencia bien cuidada. Reseñas
